question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched authority as CCP general secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.8% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Ongoing military leadership purges through early 2026, including close allies, have further centralized control without evidence of elite factionalism or succession moves ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Public appearances, policy continuity, and absence of credible challenges through mid-2026 align with historical patterns of leadership shifts occurring at scheduled congresses rather than abrupt ousters. Realistic scenarios that could still alter this outcome include an unforeseen health event, a severe economic downturn prompting internal realignment, or an external crisis eroding elite cohesion before year-end 2026.
